chunks: From him, from Ibn Fazzal, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Abdullah ibn al-Hasan, from his mother Fatima bint al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Three characteristics: whoever possesses them has completed the characteristics of faith. When he is pleased, his pleasure does not lead him into falsehood; and when he is angry, anger does not lead him out of the truth; and when he is able, he does not exceed what is not for him.'
ai.seo_question: What are the three characteristics that complete the faith of a believer according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni presents this hadith as a definitive criterion for the 'Momin,' linking emotional regulation directly to theological integrity. The third trait, avoiding overreach in power, reflects the Shia emphasis on justice (Adl) and self-restraint, ensuring that authority is exercised within divine bounds rather than personal desire. This triad serves as a practical framework for spiritual maturity, where inner peace and external action are harmonized with truth.
